_comment: Copy me to config.json and paste your keys. config.json is gitignored, so your keys never leave this machine.
_tavily: Optional. Gives paragraph 1 of a mail one current-news line, from app.tavily.com (the free tier is enough). Without a key the mail simply has no news sentence. Env var TAVILY_API_KEY overrides this.
_llm: Optional. Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Without it the Queue tab still works - drafts come from your templates instead. Env vars OPENAI_API_KEY / OPENAI_BASE_URL / OPENAI_MODEL override these, so a key need never touch this file.
_mail: How the Validate & send button actually behaves. 'dry' builds and checks the message but never transmits it - keep it until you have read a few real drafts. 'live' sends through SMTP the moment you press Validate on a row.

mail.smtp_password: your 16-character app password, not your account password
